name: Cross-Agent Delegation
description: Delegate work to teammate agents on shared projects via the brain delegate action. Fleet-only and project-scoped: delegation exists only within a project that has a team and a GChat space. Primes never delegate — they operate fleet agents directly.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When project work should be assigned to a teammate agent on the same project instead of done locally. Only valid within a project that has a GChat space.
